BiblicalUsage: Esther is the Jewish orphan raised by her cousin Mordecai who became queen of Persia, and her Hebrew name Hadassah means myrtle while Esther means star. She risked her life to go before the king uninvited, saying that if she perished, she perished, and her courage saved her people from Haman's plot. The book that bears her name never mentions God by name, yet His hand is everywhere in it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Esther shows that God places His people where they are needed before they know why, and courage is saying yes when the moment comes. Her story is my reminder that I may be here for such a time as this.
